text:
Jared: Quick SEO check before we publish the webinar + recording. Need one-page checklist: canonical, schema for both Event + VideoObject, AMP redirect handling, and inbound tagging. Who can take which?

Nina: I can do canonical + meta. Proposed canonical: /webinars/inference-playbook-advanced (keeps branding consistent). Meta title: "Inference Playbook (Advanced): Latency vs Cost | Redwood". Meta desc: "Live benchmarks and a practical playbook to lower LLM inference costs without sacrificing latency. Register now."

Priyanka: I'll author the JSON-LD blocks. Keep minimal but include both Event and VideoObject for the recording. Example to paste in head: 
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@graph": [
    {"@type":"Event","name":"Inference Playbook (Advanced)","startDate":"2026-06-15T17:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/inference-playbook-advanced"}},
    {"@type":"VideoObject","name":"Inference Playbook recording","uploadDate":"2026-06-16T10:00:00Z","contentUrl":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/inference-playbook-advanced/recording"}
  ]
}
```
I'll also add an FAQ item for recording availability and enterprise relevance.

Miles: Redirects & AMP: we have some AMP pages and legacy tags that need one-to-one redirects and preserved UTMs. Draft Netlify/_redirects lines (no chains):
```
/amp/webinar-inference-legacy   /webinars/inference-playbook-advanced   301
/webinar-inference-old          /webinars/inference-playbook-advanced   301
/benchmarks/inference-draft     /benchmarks/inference-economics         301
```
Important: for AMP we need to add rel=amphtml on canonical and a server-side redirect for the AMP URL to the canonical with UTM preserved.

Jared: Inbound routing: use utm_campaign=inference_playbook_jun. All form posts must include hidden fields: utm_campaign, utm_source, and source=webinar. HubSpot workflow: tag leads as webinar_inference_playbook, mark MQL if attended OR watched recording and time_on_site > 180s, and assign to AE queue for companies > 30 employees.

Priyanka: Also note open graph + twitter card: use same canonical, OG image points to /assets/og/inference-playbook.png, and add `nosnippet` only if we need to hide pricing. Otherwise keep meta open for better CTR.

SeoCrawler: Crawl scheduled at 2050008000 0: will report: missing canonical, redirect chains >1 hop, AMP redirect mismatches, and JSON-LD schema problems.

Nina: I'll push the meta + rel=canonical to staging and tag the PR. Priyanka, paste JSON-LD into the head; Miles open redirect PR and include AMP note.

Miles: Will open redirect PR at 09:45 PT with Netlify preview and redirect-checker output. I'll also add a short test plan to verify AMP redirects preserve querystring.

Jared: Great. Hold newsletter until SeoCrawler returns green. Update the launch board with owners. Thanks all :rocket:
